title: Design Instagram
description: Design a photo-sharing service with a bounded video extension, durable media publication and a follower-based home feed.
functionalRequirements: Publish photos and view a follower-based home feed
Follow or unfollow accounts and page through posts
Enforce private-account visibility and post deletion
nonFunctionalRequirements: Feed metadata server p95 below 300 ms within a region
No successful publication before media is durable and no unauthorized private-content access
constraints: 10 million DAU, 1 million photo posts/day and 100 million feed page reads/day; plan for 5x peaks
A feed page contains 20 post references; average source photo is 2 MiB
Videos, thumbnails and replicas require additional byte and compute budgets
outOfScope: Exact company-scale facts; use the stated practice workload

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.

storageEstimates.name: 30-day source-photo cohort, excluding derivatives and videos

stateEstimates.name: 500 cached references per daily active recipient

notes: One page read returns 20 references; serving all embedded post metadata requires a separate access/caching budget.
Feed reference bytes exclude data-structure overhead, post metadata and cache replication beyond the explicit factor.
Photo sizing does not pretend video processing or all historical media is included.
